question: Why does the path beginning with Sadāśiva require an eternal material cause?
premises: The path beginning with Sadāśiva is subject to change.
Changeable entities require a material cause.
Such a material cause must be eternal.
inference: Therefore the path beginning with Sadāśiva presupposes an eternal material cause.
plain_english: This path beginning with Sadāśiva is also subject to change; therefore it must have an eternal material cause.
